admission.justification: The obligation is one member of the reading-place family's joint guarantee; no other admission criterion is claimed.

applicability: Every navigation in the Knowledge reader.
conditions: A followed link opens the document at its top.
Back returns to the place the reader left.
The shareable address of MIK-R29 keeps working.
exclusions: A reload of the shareable address, which lands at the top.
statement: New reader navigation starts at the top and browser Back restores the position stored in the visited history entry.
